Messages.Author: Road Kill
Messages.Body:
thank's for all the responses.  now. since Normal (malkavian) could
have blocked.  my opponent [who read the responses] said he wouldn't have
attempted to finish me off with his 2 remaining untapped vampire [1 of
which was Ozmo a malkavian]

MADNNESS NETWORK was in effect in the game... so the next question is
would normal start to hunt at the end of my opponnents turn... which 
would Tap him, and let Ozmo bleed me (he has +1 bleed, so that wouilda killed me), or could Normal not do anything between turns (since madness networks
just give you the option of taking an action)?

Messages.Author: Tom Wylie
Messages.Body:
Road Kill <wombat@wam.umd.edu> wrote:
>MADNNESS NETWORK was in effect in the game... so the next question is
>would normal start to hunt at the end of my opponnents turn... which 
>would Tap him, and let Ozmo bleed me (he has +1 bleed, so that wouilda killed
>me), or could Normal not do anything between turns (since madness networks
>just give you the option of taking an action)?

I would say that Normal isn't required to take advantage of the Madness
Network in order to hunt, but can't take any actions while he's out of blood.
Only when it gets back to your minion phase would hunting be required.
I will double check that.
